resources.string: Choose a service and model to start using the assistant.
Saved model settings could not be opened. Open this page to set them up again.
Save makes this the active service. Each service keeps its own settings; switching services discards unsaved edits.
OpenAI-compatible API base URL. MobileClaw adds /chat/completions automatically.
No Authorization header will be sent.
The base URL changed, so the previous key was cleared. Enter a key for this address to connect.
1,024–128,000 estimated input tokens, including the system prompt and full tool catalog. The 8,000-token local default may be too small; increase it within your model\'s context limit.
Enable for a vision-capable model. Connection checks will include a generated test image.
Tests the current form without saving. Uses fixed test content, with no notifications, files, contacts, or device actions.
Remove this service\'s saved API key and settings. Other service profiles are kept.
Saved. New requests use this service.
Saved. Add an API key to use this service.
Saved settings for this service were cleared.
Could not load saved settings. You can enter new settings or clear this service.
Could not save settings. Your changes have not been applied. Please try again.
Could not clear this service. Please try again.
The connection check could not finish. Check the address, key, model ID, and network, then try again.
Connection check canceled. Tap Test connection to try again.
Connection checks finished. These results apply to the current form.
Check the base URL, model ID, authentication, and advanced settings.
Use an HTTPS URL without credentials, query, or fragment. HTTP is supported for localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1, or the emulator host 10.0.2.2.
Enter an API key, or choose None for a server without authentication.
Enter a whole number from 5 to 900.
Enter a whole number from 1,024 to 128,000.
These checks test API compatibility, not model quality. They do not change the saved profile.
